am writing to express my deep disappointment and frustration regarding an appalling experience I recently had with Dr. Zaman at your practice. I have been a registered patient with this GP for over 10 years, and I have always valued the care I received — until this incident, which has completely shattered my trust.

I attended an appointment solely to support my sister, who was the patient that day. It was not my appointment, and Dr. Zaman is not even my assigned doctor. During the consultation, I asked a polite and reasonable question regarding my sister’s condition. In response, Dr. Zaman spoke to me in a rude, disrespectful, and dismissive manner that left both of us shocked.

To make matters even worse, I later discovered that I had been removed from the GP practice entirely — without any discussion, justification, or chance to explain myself. This decision is completely unjustified, especially given that I was not even the patient in the consultation. I did nothing wrong, and yet I have been treated as though I had.

I have repeatedly tried to speak to someone higher up about this issue and have requested to speak with Dr. Razak, but no one has responded. Instead, I have been falsely accused, ignored, and denied the basic fairness of being heard.

This entire experience has been deeply upsetting and distressing, and it is unacceptable that a long-term patient should be treated in such a disrespectful and discriminatory manner. I am now struggling to find healthcare because of this completely unfair removal, and I find it heartbreaking that this is how your practice chooses to treat loyal patients.

I am demanding that this matter be taken seriously and that a formal investigation be opened immediately. I expect a written explanation and apology, as well as reinstatement as a patient at the practice.

I look forward to a prompt response.",null,[0,238]]]],[null,null,null,null,null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/9025419080396033554/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMmt4UWxaVmNIQmlWV3h6VTJ4V1FrOUVUa1poTVhBMVZFUlNXbFJYWXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/9025419080396033554/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMmt4UWxaVmNIQmlWV3h6VTJ4V1FrOUVUa1poTVhBMVZFUlNXbFJYWXhBQhAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/9025419080396033554/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMmt4UWxaVmNIQmlWV3h6VTJ4V1FrOUVUa1poTVhBMVZFUlNXbFJYWXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/9025419080396033554/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMmt4UWxaVmNIQmlWV3h6VTJ4V1FrOUVUa1poTVhBMVZFUlNXbFJYWXhBQhAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/9025419080396033554/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMmt4UWxaVmNIQmlWV3h6VTJ4V1FrOUVUa1poTVhBMVZFUlNXbFJYWXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/9025419080396033554/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMmt4UWxaVmNIQmlWV3h6VTJ4V1FrOUVUa1poTVhBMVZFUlNXbFJYWXhBQhAA"]],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2kxQlZVcHBiVWxzU2xWQk9ETkZhMXA1VERSWlRXYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x5db742532887f9ee!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOi1BVUppbUlsSlVBODNFa1p5TDRZTWc%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2kxQlZVcHBiVWxzU2xWQk9ETkZhMXA1VERSWlRXYxAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjBtMiNh7CTAxVvRAkBHQB3D7MQoykICigB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjBtMiNh7CTAxVvRAkBHQB3D7MQ0pMFCAgoAg"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBeHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMWxwZVdGSlZsOWZSV2hCTjB4NVdsaDVkSGxmWldkWVoxTlNTVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpTVFVOYWFVeEtiMmhWV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25Zd01IUlliWGw0YlhkTFN6WXRRekE0UzJscGRrRRAB",["0x0:0x5db742532887f9ee",null,1755537338039735,1755537338039735,[null,null,["https://ww
